status: APPROVED semantic mapping. Source of truth for the future Android values/colors.xml and values-night/colors.xml.

derivedFrom.method: Equivalent nodes matched one-to-one across the two canonical Figma pages; every theme-changing fill, stroke and text colour was collected and grouped by UI role.

whyNotInFigma.reason: Figma limits a variable collection to a single mode on the Starter plan, so a Light/Dark variable pair cannot exist in the file.
whyNotInFigma.consequence: The mapping lives here instead. Nothing in Figma is bound to a variable; the pages keep their raw fills, which is correct - binding to single-mode variables would make both pages resolve to the same colour.
whyNotInFigma.ifPlanChanges: If the file ever moves to a plan with multiple modes, this file is the input: create Radio Myata / Semantic with modes Light and Dark and bind the listed node ids.
